name: There Are Two Wolves Inside Of You; Both Of Them Are Gay
source:
Two wolves, one chipmunk!

In a world where everyone can split in twain, poor little Preston was born with a dysfunctional Twain Gland. One day he meets Wulfhram and his life will never be the same. 

Join Preston on a short journey of self-discovery over the course of a few days in the city Dimondwright.

[From [url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/there-are-two-wolves-inside-of-you-both-of-them-are-gay]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两只狼，一只花栗鼠！

在这个人人都能一分为二的世界里，可怜的普雷斯顿却天生分体腺功能异常。某天，他遇见了沃尔弗拉姆，生活从此再也不同。

陪伴普雷斯顿，在戴蒙德赖特市度过几天，踏上一段短暂的自我探索之旅。
